name: Leading Edge Data Centres Albury-Wodonga
notes: Tier III regional edge data centre (~A$7M, built with Schneider Electric) serving the Albury-Wodonga cross-border region; one of LEDC's 26-site regional NSW rollout (trade press); operational since ~2020-21; capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Bathurst
notes: Tier III data centre proposed on Panorama Avenue next to Bathurst TAFE (Bathurst Regional LGA); Bathurst Regional Council approved the development application; listed as 'coming soon' major project on council investment site; one of 14 LEDC sites across regional NSW; capacity not disclosed.

name: CDC Marsden Park Data Centre (SSD-70889211)
notes: State Significant Development SSD-70889211 at Marsden Park Industrial Precinct (Blacktown LGA); CDC broke ground 25 Oct 2024; billed as largest data centre campus in the Southern Hemisphere; ~500MW campus capacity per DCD reporting (campus/ultimate, not phase-1 IT load).

name: Project Atlas Data Centre, Eastern Creek (SSD-101067971)
notes: ~A$5bn Goodman data centre campus at 10 Roberts Road, Eastern Creek (Blacktown LGA); SEARs request filed Jan 2026; 500MVA grid connection, GFA 99,310 sqm across two buildings (3-4 storeys); SSD-101067971; capacity stored as MVA in notes - not converted to IT MW.

name: CDC Eastern Creek campus (EC1-EC6)
notes: Eastern Creek campus (Blacktown LGA): 281MW campus with EC1-EC4 operational and EC5-EC6 under construction per DCD May 2024; verify phase split against CDC official pages before treating 281MW as operational.

name: AirTrunk SYD1
notes: AirTrunk SYD1 hyperscale facility at Huntingwood (Blacktown LGA); part of 450+MW Western Sydney cluster with SYD2/SYD3 (BWS case study); operational per official AirTrunk locations page; per-site capacity not disclosed.

name: AirTrunk SYD3
notes: AirTrunk SYD3 in Western Sydney (Huntingwood area, Blacktown LGA, per Baxtel proximity to SYD1); DA documents cite >320MW across 123,000 sqm seven-storey building; billed as largest independent hyperscale DC in Asia-Pacific (BWS); A$4.3B Blackstone debt financing reported 2026; 320MW is planned/ultimate capacity.

name: Microsoft Honeman Close Data Centre (SSD-58601963)
notes: 6 Honeman Close, Huntingwood (Blacktown LGA); 96MW data centre proposed for Microsoft (developer LCI); SSD-58601963 per AU methodology seed list; DCD reporting is from proposed stage - re-verify current determination on NSW Planning Portal.

name: DCI Data Centers SYD02/SYD03
notes: DCI Data Centers received SSD approval for SYD02/SYD03 adjacent to AirTrunk SYD1 at Huntingwood (Blacktown LGA), per Baxtel directory entry; weak source - verify via NSW Planning Portal before promoting grade.
